fruits.extendedStory: Diocletian was an emperor who punished Christians. In the 7th century his tomb was turned into a church, and the altars were given the relics of Domnius and Anastasius. Both were martyrs who died at Solin, just up the road, in his own lifetime. So the emperor and the people he wronged now share one roof. The bell tower stands 57 metres tall and was begun in the 13th century.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Diokletian war ein Kaiser, der Christen verfolgte. Im 7. Jahrhundert wurde sein Grabmal zur Kirche, und die Altäre erhielten die Reliquien von Domnius und Anastasius. Beide waren Märtyrer, die im nahen Solin zu seinen Lebzeiten starben. So teilen sich der Kaiser und jene, denen er Unrecht tat, heute ein Dach. Der Glockenturm ist 57 Meter hoch und wurde im 13. Jahrhundert begonnen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Diocletian was an emperor who punished Christians. In the 7th century his tomb was turned into a church, and the altars were given the relics of Domnius and Anastasius. Both were martyrs who died at Solin, just up the road, in his own lifetime. So the emperor and the people he wronged now share one roof. The bell tower stands 57 metres tall and was begun in the 13th century.

localizedStory.de: Unter allen Kathedralen Europas steht diese im ältesten Gebäude. Erbaut wurde es als Grabmal für Kaiser Diokletian.
localizedStory.en: Of all the cathedrals in Europe, this one sits in the oldest building. It was built as a tomb for the emperor Diocletian.

fruits.name: katedrala svetog Duje
fruits.story: Of all the cathedrals in Europe, this one sits in the oldest building. It was built as a tomb for the emperor Diocletian.

fruits.extendedStory: The market did not always stand here. It began on the Fruit Square and outgrew it as the town filled with people who needed feeding. So it moved to the palace wall, where there was room. Today it runs the length of that wall and wraps around the church of St Dominic. Colour, smell and noise. This is the working end of the old town.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Markt stand nicht immer hier. Er begann auf dem Obstplatz und wurde zu klein, als die Stadt wuchs und immer mehr Menschen zu versorgen waren. Also zog er an die Palastmauer, wo Platz war. Heute zieht er sich an dieser Mauer entlang und um die Kirche des Heiligen Dominik herum. Farben, Gerüche, Lärm. Hier arbeitet die Altstadt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The market did not always stand here. It began on the Fruit Square and outgrew it as the town filled with people who needed feeding. So it moved to the palace wall, where there was room. Today it runs the length of that wall and wraps around the church of St Dominic. Colour, smell and noise. This is the working end of the old town.

localizedStory.de: Die Spliter nennen diesen Markt den Magen der Stadt. Er zieht sich an der Ostmauer des Diokletianspalastes entlang und um eine Kirche herum.
localizedStory.en: Split calls this market the belly of the city. It runs along the east wall of Diocletian's palace and curls around a church.

fruits.name: Pazar
fruits.story: Split calls this market the belly of the city. It runs along the east wall of Diocletian's palace and curls around a church.

fruits.extendedStory: The Romans called it Porta septemtrionalis, which simply means the northern gate. It dates from 293. The road leading out of it ran straight to Salona, in those days the capital of the Roman province of Dalmatia. The golden name came much later. Under Venice, in the 16th century, people began calling it Porta Aurea, and that is the name it kept.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Römer nannten es Porta septemtrionalis, das heißt einfach Nordtor. Es stammt aus dem Jahr 293. Die Straße, die hier hinausführte, lief schnurstracks nach Salona, damals Hauptstadt der römischen Provinz Dalmatien. Der goldene Name kam viel später. Unter venezianischer Herrschaft nannte man es im 16. Jahrhundert Porta Aurea, und dabei blieb es.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The Romans called it Porta septemtrionalis, which simply means the northern gate. It dates from 293. The road leading out of it ran straight to Salona, in those days the capital of the Roman province of Dalmatia. The golden name came much later. Under Venice, in the 16th century, people began calling it Porta Aurea, and that is the name it kept.

localizedStory.de: Durch dieses Tor durften nur der Kaiser und seine Familie gehen. Heute darf es jeder. Davor steht ein bronzener Bischof, Gregor aus Nin.
localizedStory.en: The emperor and his family could walk through this gate. Nobody else could. Outside it stands a bronze bishop, Grgur Ninski.

fruits.name: Zlatna vrata
fruits.story: The emperor and his family could walk through this gate. Nobody else could. Outside it stands a bronze bishop, Grgur Ninski.

fruits.extendedStory: Look across the square and you will find an octagonal stone tower. It is what remains of a fort raised in the 15th century, when Split was still a small town. The palace came later, in the 17th century, with a baroque front of carved stone. Baroque means grand and full of curves. Farm women from the villages around once spread their fruit on this ground.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Schau über den Platz. Dort steht ein achteckiger Steinturm. Er ist der Rest einer Festung aus dem 15. Jahrhundert, als Split noch eine kleine Stadt war. Der Palast kam später, im 17. Jahrhundert, mit einer Barockfassade aus behauenem Stein. Barock heißt prunkvoll und voller Schwünge. Bäuerinnen aus den Dörfern ringsum breiteten hier einst ihr Obst aus.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Look across the square and you will find an octagonal stone tower. It is what remains of a fort raised in the 15th century, when Split was still a small town. The palace came later, in the 17th century, with a baroque front of carved stone. Baroque means grand and full of curves. Farm women from the villages around once spread their fruit on this ground.

localizedStory.de: Die Familie Milesi baute dieses Haus im 17. Jahrhundert. Der Platz davor heißt bis heute Obstplatz, nach dem Markt, der ihn einst füllte.
localizedStory.en: The Milesi family built this house in the 17th century. The square it faces is still the Fruit Square, after the market that filled it.

fruits.name: Palača Milesi
fruits.story: The Milesi family built this house in the 17th century. The square it faces is still the Fruit Square, after the market that filled it.

fruits.extendedStory: The smell comes from a sulphur spring beside the market. Those are the same waters that drew Diocletian here. His joints ached, and the springs were said to help, which is one reason he built his palace on this spot. So the emperor's rheumatism is why your fish stays fresh. The hall itself is over 120 years old.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Geruch kommt von einer Schwefelquelle gleich neben dem Markt. Es sind dieselben Quellen, die schon Kaiser Diokletian herzogen. Seine Gelenke schmerzten, und das Wasser sollte helfen. Das war einer der Gründe, warum er seinen Palast genau hier baute. Das Rheuma des Kaisers hält also heute den Fisch frisch. Die Halle selbst ist über 120 Jahre alt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The smell comes from a sulphur spring beside the market. Those are the same waters that drew Diocletian here. His joints ached, and the springs were said to help, which is one reason he built his palace on this spot. So the emperor's rheumatism is why your fish stays fresh. The hall itself is over 120 years old.

localizedStory.de: Ein Fischmarkt, an dem keine Mücke stört. Der Schwefelgeruch aus dem Thermalbad nebenan hält sie fern.
localizedStory.en: A fish market with no flies. They keep away from the smell of sulphur drifting over from the baths next door.

fruits.name: Ribarnica
fruits.story: A fish market with no flies. They keep away from the smell of sulphur drifting over from the baths next door.

fruits.extendedStory: Franciscan friars took the church over in the 13th century, and their cloister is that old too. Inside the monastery is a library of more than 3000 old books, some from the 16th century. The ground is older still. The church was raised beside the grave of Felician, a martyr from Diocletian's own time. The politician Ante Trumbić lies here as well, under a sarcophagus carved by Ivan Meštrović.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Im 13. Jahrhundert übernahmen Franziskaner die Kirche, und ihr Kreuzgang ist ebenso alt. Im Kloster steht eine Sammlung von über 3000 alten Büchern, einige aus dem 16. Jahrhundert. Der Boden ist noch älter. Die Kirche entstand neben dem Grab eines christlichen Märtyrers aus Diokletians Zeit. Auch der Politiker Ante Trumbić ruht hier, unter einem Sarkophag von Ivan Meštrović.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Franciscan friars took the church over in the 13th century, and their cloister is that old too. Inside the monastery is a library of more than 3000 old books, some from the 16th century. The ground is older still. The church was raised beside the grave of Felician, a martyr from Diocletian's own time. The politician Ante Trumbić lies here as well, under a sarcophagus carved by Ivan Meštrović.

localizedStory.de: Hier liegt der Vater der kroatischen Literatur begraben. Marko Marulić ruht in dieser Kirche am Meer.
localizedStory.en: The father of Croatian literature is buried inside. Marko Marulić rests in this church beside the sea.

fruits.name: Crkva i samostan Sv. Frane
fruits.story: The father of Croatian literature is buried inside. Marko Marulić rests in this church beside the sea.
